note: Wyoming State Parks, a small campground on a pine-dotted point of Glendo Reservoir's Custer Cove, near Colter Bay and ~2.5 km north of Two Moon. Gravel sites. No potable water until mid-May. When the reservoir is drawn down the shore recedes across open sand, 100 m or more from most sites. --Claude
